title: Tourist Season, 2019
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: A tourist tells Wood the strip should be on a streaming service. Wood says it is on a laundromat rack. She doesn't get it. Gully does.

panels.composition: Gully's. A TOURIST, young, phone out, to WOOD on the stool.

balloons.text: You should get this animated. Like, a show. People would watch a show.
It's on a rack at the laundromat.

image.prompt: a young tourist with a phone talking to a thin man on a shop stool who answers with something she doesn't understand, a dog, a man in an apron, clean ink

panels.composition: Gully, wiping the counter, a small private smile.

image.prompt: close-up of a stocky man wiping a counter with a small private smile, no words

panels.composition: Wood, drawing the tourist. Kindly. Her phone, in the drawing, is a laundromat digest.
props: pad: the tourist holding a digest

image.prompt: close-up of a sketch of a young tourist holding a small stapled zine where her phone was

panels.composition: The tourist leaving. Wood tearing the sketch out and handing it to her. She looks at it, at the digest in her hand in it, and — almost — gets it.

image.prompt: a young tourist looking at a sketch of herself holding a small zine, almost understanding, a thin man handing it over, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: 'It's on a rack at the laundromat.' Her phone drawn as a digest.
